name: swe-flow
description: LLM authoring companion to the govkit governance engine: skills and role agents that author the governed SDLC chain (PRD/RFC/ADR/US, API + data design, gate-loop close-out) and call `npx govkit verify` — never embedding the deterministic gate. Domain modelling lives in the sibling ddd-flow plugin, experience design in design-flow; siblings meet at artifacts, never imports.
